content.text:
The document has a single Preamble section; I've located the indemnity architecture. Vendor indemnity at p0047–p0051, Customer's at p0052, procedures at p0053–p0055, and the LoL carve-out at p0027.

Assessment:
- **Vendor indemnity present and broad**: Kubient defends/indemnifies AP and its officers, directors, agents and employees against all third-party Claims (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of the Services, the Auction Platform, Kubient's breach of any representation or warranty, and the acts or omissions of Kubient or its subcontractors.
- **IP infringement covered**: claims "arising out of or in connection with… the Services… the Auction Platform" capture infringement allegations, and Kubient's warranties at p0039–p0040 (rightful owner/licensee of all IP rights in the Service, Auction Platform and products) are themselves indemnified via limb (iv). Breach of law (p0041) and Kubient's acts/omissions likewise flow through.
- **Procedure**: notice, control of defence, cooperation at indemnitor's cost — with a pro-indemnitee twist that late notice does not relieve the indemnifying party.
- **No cap problem**: p0027 carves indemnification out of the consequential-damages exclusion; no super-cap or sub-cap is applied to Kubient's indemnity.
- **Customer indemnity**: keyed to AP's Content and Properties, unauthorised use, and AP's own breach/acts — no reciprocal indemnity for Kubient's own Services.

input.quote: (a) Kubient agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Customer and its officers, directors, managers, members, agents, and employees from all third-party allegations, claims, actions, losses, expenses, damages, costs (including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys' fees) or liabilities ("Claims") arising out of or in connection with:
input.rationale: The Agreement contains a vendor-side defence and indemnity that meets the preferred position on its material terms. Kubient defends, indemnifies and holds harmless AP and its officers, directors, managers, members, agents and employees against all third-party Claims (expressly including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of or in connection with the Services (p0048), the Auction Platform (p0049), Kubient's breach of any representation or warranty, and the acts or omissions of Kubient or its subcontractors (p0051). Third-party IP infringement is captured: claims "arising out of or in connection with" the Services and the Auction Platform reach infringement allegations, and limb (iv) indemnifies breach of Kubient's warranties, which include that it owns or controls the rights granted to AP and is the rightful owner or licensee of all IP rights to the Service, Auction Platform and products delivered (p0039, p0040). Kubient's compliance-with-Law warranty (p0041) and the acts/omissions limb likewise pick up breach of law, Vendor-caused data incidents and gross negligence/wilful misconduct. Standard procedure is present (prompt notice, indemnitor control of defence with no liability-admitting settlement without consent, cooperation at the indemnifying party's cost), and notice delay does not relieve the indemnifying party — a pro-AP formulation. The indemnity is uncapped in practice: p0027 carves "THE PARTIES' LIABILITY FOR INDEMNIFICATION" out of the consequential-damages exclusion, and no super-cap or sub-cap is imposed, so the fallback's 3x-fees ceiling is not needed. AP's own indemnity (p0052) is directionally correct — keyed to its Content and Properties, unauthorised or inappropriate use, and its own breach and acts/omissions — with no reciprocal indemnity for Kubient's Services. Two minor sub-elements fall short of the ideal preferred wording and are noted rather than flagged: the Creative limb (p0050) carries a "to the best of its knowledge" qualifier, and AP's indemnity extends slightly beyond Customer-provided content and breach of law to unauthorised use and breach of any representation or warranty. Neither is material, and per playbook semantics these are recorded here instead of being redlined. No walk-away condition exists.
